description: This file defines the NodeApp class, an Android Application subclass responsible for managing the lifecycle and runtime instance of the application, including initialization logic and debugging policies.

classes.name: NodeApp
classes.description: An Application subclass that initializes and manages the application's runtime environment and debugging policies.

methods.name: ensureRuntime
methods.description: Ensures that a singleton instance of NodeRuntime exists; creates it if necessary.

methods.name: peekRuntime
methods.description: Returns the current NodeRuntime instance if available, otherwise null.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Overrides the Application's onCreate method to set up debug policies when in debug mode.
